fact: At a workshop on the Civil Status Code held in Nouakchott on Sunday 23 March 2025, the Ministry of Justice's acting secretary general said the government had set up the national agency for the population register and secure documents, which developed the modern biometric civil status system, and the magistrates' club said courts had been issuing about 150,000 civil status judgments a year.
title: Mauritanie/Etat civil: Organisation d’un atelier sur le Code de l’état civil
